title: Articles
recall: a/an, the va artiklsiz holatlarni ayt. Umumiy ma'noda ko'plik va sanalmaydigan otlar bilan nima bo'ladi?
formula: a/an: birinchi marta, biror bitta, kasb (She's a teacher)
the: ma'lum, yagona (the sun), oldin aytilgan, superlative (the best), daryo/okean/tog' tizmasi
artiklsiz: umumiy ma'noda ko'plik/sanalmaydigan (Dogs are loyal, Water is important), ko'p mamlakat va shahar nomlari, ovqat nomlari, go to school/work/bed

pairs.a: I saw a dog. The dog was black.

en: She's a teacher.
He's a teacher.
She is a teacher.

items.uz: Men kecha bir film ko'rdim. Film juda zo'r edi.
en: I saw a film yesterday. The film was great.
I watched a movie yesterday. The movie was great.
Dogs are loyal animals.
The sun rises in the east.
I can't live without coffee.
It's the tallest building in the world.
It is the highest building in the world.
I go to bed at 11.
I go to bed at eleven.
Love is more important than anything.
Love is the most important thing.
The Amu Darya flows into the Aral Sea.
I live in Tashkent.
He studies in the United States.
She studies in the USA.
He studies in the US.
I need some advice.
I need advice.
Can you play the piano?
What did you have for breakfast?
What did you eat for breakfast?
He's in hospital.
She is in hospital.
He's in the hospital.

items.uz: Men har kuni ishga avtobusda boraman.
en: I go to work by bus every day.
I take the bus to work every day.
It's a very interesting book.
This is a very interesting book.
People are smarter than animals.
Humans are cleverer than animals.

items.uz: U yilda bir marta Londonga boradi.
en: She goes to London once a year.
He goes to London once a year.

items.uz: Bolalarni mening onam maktabga olib boradi.
en: My mother takes the children to school.
My mum takes the kids to school.

speak: Kecha ko'rgan narsalaringizni gapiring: a → the (5 ta gap).
Umumiy fikrlar: hayvonlar, pul, sport haqida 3 ta gap (artiklsiz).
